newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: TENNIS-FIRST ROUND EXIT FOR KAFELNIKOV, FERREIRA.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-FIRST ROUND EXIT FOR KAFELNIKOV, FERREIRA.

text.p: Top seed Yevgeny Kafelnikov, recently recovered from a broken finger, and third seed Wayne Ferreira of South Africa were both beaten in the first round of the $625,000 Estoril Open on Wednesday.
The 22-year-old Russian world number four, the defending French Open champion, was crushed 6-2 6-0 by Austrian Gilbert Schaller at the national stadium in Lisbon.

Kafelnikov, who broke the little finger of his right hand while training before the start of the Australian Open in January, has now lost in the first round of the event three times in the last four years.
Francisco Cabello of Argentina disposed of Ferreira 6-3 3-6 6-4 while, in a second round match, second seed Carlos Moya of Spain beat Australian Richard Fromberg 6-2 6-3.
